item.title: Historic Junction Courthouse. Circa 1903. On 1.5 acres in Utah. $1,150,000
item.description: This is a neat building! It is the Historic Junction Courthouse. The courthouse was built in 1903. It is located on 1.54 acres in Kingston, Utah. The building was designed by architect, Richard C. Watkins. The building is situated on the Paiute Trail System and only five minutes from the Piute Reservoir, Lots of possibilities with this! Eight bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,983 square feet. $1,150,000 From the Zillow listing: The Historic Junction Courthouse was built in 1903 as the Piute County

item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1870. Two acres in Vermont. $279,950
item.description: This house has pretty exterior details! The house was built in 1870. It is located on two acres in Ryegate, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, a claw foot tub, french doors, spacious kitchen and pressed tin ceilings. Pretty rural setting. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,356 square feet. $279,950 Contact Mathew Gafoori with RE/MAX Heritage: 802-748-7808 From the Zillow listing: A Historic Farmhouse in a picturesque rural setting; enjoy beautiful Vermon

item.title: Great porch! Pretty coffered ceiling! On 3/4 acre in North Carolina. $199,000
item.description: This house has some really nice details! I love the porch and the coffered ceiling! The house was built in 1928. It is located on .74 acre in Warsaw, North Carolina. The house features a large covered porch, a porte cochere, wood floors, pocket doors, coffered ceiling, brick fireplace, leaded glass window, transom windows, wide baseboards, nice butler’s pantry and picture rails. This house has a lot of potential! Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,721 square feet. $199,000 Contact Norwood West

item.title: Nice porch! Circa 1902 in Virginia. $115,000
item.description: Nice porch! This looks like the type of house where you could move in and work room by room as time and money allowed. The house was built in 1902. It is located on .41 acre in Victoria, Virginia. The house features a large covered front porch, original wood flooring, baseboards, picture rails, pretty mantel, chair rails and wainscoting. item.title: Pretty setting and view! C. 1881. Over two acres in Virginia. $180,000
item.description: This has a pretty setting and pretty views! Definitely a fixer upper, but it has potential! Wish there were more interior pictures. The house was built in 1881. It is located on 2.63 acres in Sugar Grove, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, stone hearth, crown moulding and a nice staircase. There is a spring-fed pond and a detached garage on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,200 square feet. $180,000 Contact Cynthia Routon with Holston Realty: 615-574-

item.title: Channel Bass Inn, Circa 1892 on Chincoteague Island, Virginia. $990,000
item.description: This is such a beautiful location in Virginia! Neat opportunity for someone that has wanted a bed and breakfast! The Channel Bass Inn was built in 1892. It is located Chincoteague Island, Virginia. This is a big structure! This inn has won awards for best bed and breakfast at national, state and local levels for 2023, 2024 and 2025. There is a professional commercial kitchen. Ten bedrooms, twelve bathrooms and 6,970 square feet. $990,000 Contact Shawn Jennings with Coldwell Banker Harbour Realty

item.title: Tall ceilings! Cute house! Circa 1920 in Alabama. $159,900
item.description: This house has nice tall ceilings! It’s a cute house! The home was built in 1920. It is located on .67 acre in Centreville, Alabama. The house features a small covered front porch, tall ceilings, updated kitchen, wood floors, solid wood doors with original hardware, updated bathroom, wood walls, crown moulding, wood ceilings and baseboards. item.title: Cute cabin in California! Circa 1934. $349,000
item.description: This is a cute cabin! Would make a nice getaway spot! The cabin was built in 1934. It is located on .29 acre in Cazadero, California. The cabin features a large deck, knotty pine walls, knotty pine ceilings, wood floors, stone hearth and a cute bathroom. There are mature trees on the property. Just minutes to town.
